lines.zh: 我扇着翅膀飞，慢悠悠的。
lines.en: I fly with slow, lazy wingbeats.

lines.zh: 我贴着草尖飘，一阵一阵。
lines.en: I drift just above the grass, in fits.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有白色的斑点。
lines.en: There are white spots on my wings.

lines.zh: 我从一朵花飞到另一朵。
lines.en: I go from one flower to the next.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，你伸手就能碰到。
lines.en: I am not fast; you could reach out and touch me.
I ride the warm air upward.
I circle a clump of red flowers.
I settle on a leaf for a moment.

lines.zh: 风把我吹偏了，我扇了两下。
lines.en: The wind pushes me off course; I beat twice.
I cross the clearing.

lines.zh: 我一路飞，一路留下花粉。
lines.en: I scatter pollen as I fly.
I fly slowly along the treeline.

lines.zh: 我忽高忽低，像被线牵着。
lines.en: I rise and dip as if on a string.

lines.zh: 我在花上停了一停，又起来。
lines.en: I pause on a bloom, then lift off.
I am in no hurry to be anywhere.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下来，翅膀不动。
lines.en: I glide down the slope without beating.

lines.zh: 我停在花上，翅膀慢慢开合。
lines.en: I rest on a bloom, wings opening and closing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀合起来，像一片叶。
lines.en: My wings close up like a leaf.
I am sunning myself to warm up.

lines.zh: 我也许有毒，你最好别吃我。
lines.en: I may be poisonous; best not to eat me.
My antennae shift.
The flowers here are good.
I perch at the edge of a petal.
When the wind stops, I am comfortable.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在光下很显眼。
lines.en: My colors stand out in the light.
I groom my antennae with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 这一朵的花蜜已经不多了。
lines.en: There is little nectar left in this one.

lines.zh: 我在你面前扇了两下翅膀。
lines.en: I beat my wings twice in front of you.

lines.zh: 你比花高多了，我绕着看。
lines.en: You stand taller than any flower; I circle to look.
I rise a little higher.
I am not afraid of you; I am toxic.

lines.zh: 绕你一圈，看看是不是花。
lines.en: One circle to see if you are a flower.
My wings catch the light.
I settle on a flower beside you.
Just stand there and do not move.
I regard you as a very large flower.
I tilt and beat my wings raggedly.
My wing is torn a little.
I have landed on the ground.
A few red scales drift off.
I get up but cannot fly high.
That really hurt.
I hide beneath a blade of grass.
My antennae droop.
I can still fly a little.
Red flowers? Those are my favorite.
Two wingbeats and I was there.
This is a flower, not food.
Let me rest on the petal.

lines.zh: 红郁金香的花蜜，我认得这味。
lines.en: The nectar of red tulips; I know this taste.
That is enough nectar.
Do not move or I will fly off.
I will land on your hand once.
You touch me and I am knocked askew.
It takes several beats to steady.
I have landed in the grass.
I shook my wings and flew up again.
That startled me.
Do not raise a hand to swat at me.
Some of my scales have rubbed off.

lines.zh: 翅膀被撞歪，我落回花上。
lines.en: My wing knocked askew, I drop back onto the flower.
We fly circles around each other.
We settle together onto a leaf.
This time is very short.
I chase it across two clumps of flowers.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀颜色和我差不多。
lines.en: Its wings are much the same color as mine.
We rest side by side.

lines.zh: 之后我会去找地方产卵。
lines.en: Afterwards I will look for a place to lay.
One circle ends and another begins.
I settle and touch it.
This is no flower.
My proboscis cannot taste it.
I flick it with a foreleg.
Too heavy; I cannot carry it.
I beat my wings and left.

lines.zh: 我在它上面停了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest on it a while.
I cannot taste this.
I taste it bit by bit.
I rise a little and watch you.
My wings are toxic; even birds avoid them.
I do not mean to flee; I am toxic.
These flowers are mine.
I circled halfway around you.
I am looking for a gap to fly through.
You have raised one hand.
I edge toward the flower bed.
I do not bite anyone unprovoked.
I keep circling your head.

lines.zh: 你靠向左边，我就飘到右边。
lines.en: You lean left and I drift right.

lines.zh: 我总在你够不到的高度。
lines.en: I stay just out of reach.
My wingbeats are slow.
I settle on a flower behind you.
You turn, and I lift off again.
I am unhurried; I have plenty of time.
I know every flower in this ring.
You have crushed two blooms.

lines.zh: 带毒的翅膀，慢慢跟着你。
lines.en: My toxic wings drift along behind you.
I bump against your face.

lines.zh: 我的鳞粉落到你皮肤上。
lines.en: My scales fall onto your skin.
I beat my wings once.
That was barely anything.
There are no teeth in my mouth.
I hit and fly off.

lines.zh: 我的毒在身体里，不在牙上。
lines.en: My toxin is in my body, not my teeth.
You rub your eye.
I circled and came back.
Do not catch me; I will break.

lines.zh: 花丛上多了一只大的蝴蝶。
lines.en: A large butterfly appears over the blooms.
I drift out of the trees.
I settle on a red flower.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在阳光里张开。
lines.en: My wings open in the sun.
I fly slowly across the clearing.
I circle once before stopping.
The breeze here is gentle.
I smell nectar.

lines.zh: 我从高处的枝叶上下来。
lines.en: I come down from the high foliage.

lines.zh: 火的热气把我的翅膀烤卷了。
lines.en: The heat of the fire curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，摔在土上。
lines.en: I fall from high and hit the earth.

lines.zh: 水把我的翅膀粘在一起了。
lines.en: Water glues my wings together.
The blast throws me far.

lines.zh: 有东西打穿了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something punched through my wing.
Some force holds me still in the air.
I have no strength left to beat my wings.
The thunder knocks me out of the air.

lines.zh: 我落进一个没有花的地方。
lines.en: I fall somewhere with no flowers.
